extracted.intended_audience: researchers and practitioners in multimodal NLP / vision-language models working on visual story generation
extracted.subtask_description: Designing, training, and evaluating multimodal models (LLMs/LVLMs) to generate coherent, emotionally resonant narratives from image sequences, including dataset construction, instruction tuning, and reinforcement learning with human/GPT-4 evaluation. Focus is on research methodology and empirical evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative coherence
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintaining narrative coherence across a sequence of images ("maintaining narrative coherence across a sequence of images, which involves understanding and linking the visual content in a meaningful way").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identified as a primary challenge; evaluated by GPT-4 and human judges. Instruction tuning and reinforcement learning are cited as key methods to improve coherence; ablation shows removing instruction tuning significantly degrades performance on coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character and scene consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensuring consistency in character appearances and scene settings across multiple frames ("Character and Scene Consistency: Ensuring consistent portrayal of characters and scenes across multiple frames").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit instruction-tuning task; improvement attributed to learned modules and instruction guidance. Evaluated in experiments (noted that baseline models struggled while the proposed method maintained consistency).

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance / contextual relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Generating narratives that are relevant to and grounded in the provided images ("relevance" / "contextual relevance").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measured by GPT-4 and human evaluation. The paper stresses relevance as part of the holistic evaluation beyond surface-level similarity metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional depth / emotional engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporating emotional and contextual elements into the narrative to produce emotionally resonant stories ("emotional depth", "emotional engagement").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as an instruction-tuning task (Emotion and Context Recognition). Quantitatively evaluated with GPT-4 scores and human ratings; reinforcement learning with GPT-4 reward helps enhance emotional richness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Composite measure of the story's overall quality as judged holistically ("Overall Quality" used as a metric in quantitative and human evaluations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a distinct score in both GPT-4 and human evaluations; improvements attributed to instruction tuning, RL, and architectural choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caption generation (image-level descriptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Generating detailed descriptions for individual images ("Caption Generation: Generating detailed descriptions for individual images").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the instruction tuning tasks used to train/fine-tune the model; helps ground later story-level generation and provides supervision for visual-text alignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story continuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating subsequent narrative sequences given an initial image and its description ("Story Continuation: Creating subsequent narrative sequences given an initial image and its description").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an instruction-tuning task to teach models to extend narratives; evaluated for coherence, plot progression, and relevance in experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotion and context recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizing and incorporating emotional states and contextual cues from images into generated narratives ("Emotion and Context Recognition: Incorporating emotional and contextual elements into the narrative").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framed as an explicit training task for instruction tuning; contributes to emotional depth and narrative naturalness, and evaluated by GPT-4/human judges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dataset diversity and annotation detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructing a comprehensive dataset with diverse visual stories and meticulous annotations ("a new dataset comprising diverse visual stories, annotated with detailed captions and multimodal elements").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dataset should source from varied domains (comics, illustrated books, educational content), include detailed captions describing events/actions/emotions, and support a wide variety of story types to improve generalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporal dynamics and multimodal alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Including multimodal datasets (e.g., video clips) with aligned textual descriptions to capture temporal dynamics and improve storytelling across time ("include multimodal datasets with video clips and aligned textual descriptions to enhance the model’s understanding of temporal dynamics").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to model temporal consistency and event progression; explicit alignment aids learning of temporal narratives and plot progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation methodology: use of GPT-4 as judge
rubrics_metrics.description: Using GPT-4 to assess generated stories on nuanced criteria ("we utilize GPT-4 to assess the quality of the generated stories based on criteria such as coherence, relevance, emotional depth, and narrative consistency").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Argued to be more holistic than traditional automatic metrics (BLEU/METEOR/CIDEr), which focus on surface-level similarity. GPT-4 provides reward signals for RL and serves as a quantitative judge for nuanced narrative qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitations of surface-level text metrics (BLEU/METEOR/CIDEr)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizing that traditional metrics (BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr) often fail to capture nuanced coherence and contextual relevance in storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paper explicitly states these metrics are useful but insufficient for story quality; motivates use of GPT-4 and human evaluation instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human evaluation aligned to model criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting human evaluations where judges rate stories using the same criteria as automated evaluation (coherence, relevance, emotional depth, overall quality).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human judgments are used to validate GPT-4 quantitative results; consistency between human and GPT-4 ratings strengthens claims of improved storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reinforcement learning with GPT-4 reward
rubrics_metrics.description: Using reinforcement learning with a reward function defined by GPT-4 evaluations to optimize narrative coherence and relevance (LRL where R(Ti, Ti) = GPT-4(Ti, Ti)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combined with supervised NLL objective in a total loss L = LNLL + λLRL; λ balances supervised and RL components. RL is credited with refining narrative quality beyond supervised fine-tuning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instruction tuning as critical training component
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction tuning via specific tasks (caption generation, story continuation, character/scene consistency, emotion/context recognition) to guide model behavior ("Instruction tuning plays a crucial role in enhancing the model’s ability to generate coherent and contextually relevant visual stories").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ablation study shows removing instruction tuning significantly degrades performance, indicating its centrality for guiding narrative generation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Architectural / learned modules contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Design choices in model architecture and learned modules influence narrative generation quality ("the specific architectural choices in our model" contribute to performance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ablation variants (w/o learned modules) show measurable drops in metrics; suggests evaluating and reporting component-level contributions is essential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character development (as a separate narrative dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to develop characters meaningfully across the story ("Character Development" listed as a distinct evaluation dimension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in detailed analysis (Table 4) as a separate metric; improved scores indicate stronger long-range character modeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot progression (event/plotline coherence)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality of plot progression and logical event sequencing ("Plot Progression" as a specific evaluation dimension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluated separately in experiments; instruction tuning and memory/attention mechanisms (cited in related work) assist in improving progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance/mitigation of object hallucination
rubrics_metrics.description: Reducing incorrect or hallucinated object mentions in generated narratives ("Addressing specific issues, such as object hallucination, remains crucial").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cited as an important challenge in LVLMs; implies evaluation should measure hallucination rates and robustness of visual grounding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of ablation studies to attribute component effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Systematically removing or modifying components (instruction tuning, reinforcement learning, learned modules) to measure their effect on performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ablation is used to show the importance of components (e.g., removing instruction tuning or RL reduces scores); recommended as a methodology to validate claims about component contributions.
